profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, traded under the ticker AUR, that works on self-driving technology for freight. Its site presents the Aurora Driver, which it describes as built from hardware and software backed by verifiable AI and designed to integrate autonomy into a customer's fleet. The company describes its aim as delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly and broadly.

The site carries endorsements from partners. One describes early results of a pilot program in which the Aurora Driver autonomously hauls freight between Fort Worth and El Paso, using a hybrid model of professional drivers and the Aurora Driver. Another says freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010-2050 and that the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous. A third says the self-driving system has performed consistently over millions of autonomous miles.

Company records list no lawsuits involving Aurora. Its legal exposure is recorded in Pennsylvania. Its SEC filing identity is CIK 0001828108.
